label: Communications Preferences
help_text: Member portal communications-preferences card. Shows an intro, a summary of subscription categories, and a CTA that links out to HubSpot's native Subscription Preferences system page (default /email-subscriptions/) - the source of truth for email consent. That system page must be assigned + published in HubSpot Settings → Website → Pages → System pages, or the link 404s. Place on profile.html (portal layout).
